item.title: Brother Martin and the Mice
item.description: A bedtime story about Saint Martin de Porres, the kind brother with the broom, who made peace between a convent full of friars and a convent full of mice. For ages 3 to 8, about ten minutes read aloud. His feast day is the 3rd of November. Setting: Lima, Peru, around the year 1610. Read the full text at https://example.invalid/hearth-and-horizon/stories/brother-martin-and-the-mice.html. Written by Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic; read by a synthetic voice. CC BY-SA 4.0.
